problem: The non-applicable branch can be satisfied solely by an allowed non-1985 regulation edition, so a targeted ship may omit the mandatory iceClass input entirely. It also permits an arbitrary iceClass value when that edition alternative is used.
required_change: Require exactly one iceClass on gen:TRF023ShipShape, constrained to the complete locked set of IA Super, IA, IB, IC, II, and III, independently of the applicability branch.
regression_guard: Preserve the conditional power requirement for IB or IC with the 1985 edition while always requiring one valid canonical iceClass.
